description: Source-linked competition glove rules for World Boxing, IBA, England Boxing, Boxing Canada, ABC professional guidance and BBBofC. Explicit sex and age group required. Returns no definitive weight where an event exception, unsupported category or unverified current source prevents it. Body weight alone does not establish the entered division. Never use this as proof a glove brand or model is approved.

competition_category_kg.description: Entered division's upper weight limit, if known. Required for a definite weight-based amateur category lookup. Not a boxer's current body weight.

event_rules_confirmed.description: For IBA elite men: whether the organiser confirmed the general 10/12 oz table applies rather than IBA-owned event exceptions.

name: paragon_glove_rules
